data.name: Empowered Attack
data.description: As an immediate action, you can expend your psionic focus and pay two power points to treat one attack made by a member of your collective as empowered.  An empowered attack deals 50%% additional damage.  The attack to be empowered cannot be modified by a similar effect such as Empower Power.
